name: musica
description: A DJ booth and a pattern studio in one browser tab, and an MCP server for agents. Two decks with beatmatch, EQ, filters, loops and key matching; a step sequencer and piano roll in the FL Studio idiom; and a crate that searches Spotify, Bandcamp, SoundCloud, YouTube and the Internet Archive at once. Everything but Spotify streams onto a deck and gets analysed for tempo and key — YouTube through yt-dlp, archive.org straight from the source. Every sample is decoded and mixed client-side through Web Audio; the module serves the console, answers the five platforms (only Spotify needs keys), proxies the two streams that lack CORS, and exposes the whole crate as 16 MCP tools at POST /mcp.

endpoints./info: Null call — what this module is and what it exposes
endpoints./decks: The mixer's signal chain, deck by deck
endpoints./kit: The synthesised drum kit and synth voices the sequencer ships with
endpoints./platforms: What Spotify, Bandcamp, SoundCloud, YouTube and the Internet Archive will and won't do from this deployment (keys masked)
endpoints./search: Search all five platforms at once, or one (q, source=all|spotify|bandcamp|soundcloud|youtube|archive, kind=track|album|artist|playlist, limit). A pasted link resolves instead.
endpoints./resolve: A Spotify, Bandcamp, SoundCloud, YouTube or archive.org link → the track, album, playlist, channel or item it names, with tracks
endpoints./stream: Where a track's audio is (source, id). SoundCloud and archive.org answer with a CORS-open URL; Bandcamp and YouTube are pulled through /stream/<source>.
endpoints./stream/bandcamp: The MP3 itself, proxied with Range passthrough — one of two non-JSON routes
endpoints./discover: Bandcamp's discover feed for a tag (tag, slice=top|new|rec, size)
endpoints./bandcamp_page: One Bandcamp album or track page, every track listed with whether it streams
endpoints./soundcloud_playlist: A SoundCloud set or album with its tracks hydrated
endpoints./album: A Spotify album with its tracks
endpoints./playlist: A Spotify playlist's tracks — public, or yours if orbit/spotify is logged in
endpoints./my_playlists: Your own Spotify playlists, via orbit/spotify's login
endpoints./spotify_status: Whether Spotify is wired up, and which endpoints this app may call
endpoints./stream/youtube: A video's best audio-only track (m4a), proxied with Range passthrough — googlevideo sends no CORS header
endpoints./youtube_video: One YouTube video's metadata (id or any watch/shorts/youtu.be URL)
endpoints./youtube_playlist: A YouTube playlist, mix or album with its videos
endpoints./youtube_channel: A channel's uploads (@handle, UC… id or channel URL)
endpoints./archive_item: One archive.org item with its tracks — each track id is identifier/filename
endpoints./archive_collection: Browse one archive.org collection: etree, netlabels, 78rpm… (id, q, limit)
endpoints./tools: The MCP tool list, as JSON
endpoints./mcp: The MCP server: POST a JSON-RPC 2.0 message (initialize, tools/list, tools/call). GET lists the tools.

transports.http: POST /mcp on the app port (and /api/musica/mcp through the gateway)

mcp.auth: none — every tool is a public read; musica_fetch writes audio into ~/.mod/musica/audio
